Homepagecarddetails1:
The formation of Sri Satya Sai Raithu Mutually Aided Cooperative Federation Ltd., (SSSR MACF) is the dream come true of Shri Trilochan Sastry, professor at IIMB, and founder member of Centre for Collective Development (CCD), a Non-Governmental Organization which is working in 5 States of India. 
 
 The Objective of the Federation is to improve the economic and social status of members of ‘Member Cooperatives’ by providing effective crop production, storage, purchase, processing, technical and marketing services as the main priorities of mutual assistance, cooperation, democratic method and self-reliance.  
 
 While CCD focused in the formation of village level cooperatives from the year 2004, the federation started confederating them to form into Federation.  The federation was registered in the year 2010 and started working for the benefit of the farmers. 
 
 The federation has now entered into value added marketing under the brand name ‘Farm Veda’, which is backed-up by CCD confederating all the federations promoted by them all over India.
Homepagecarddetails2: Initially, the Federation started its work in 4 mandals of the district with a membership strength of 540 covering 7 cooperatives, in the year 2010. However, as the fruits of benefits started reaching the members, the demand to include more villages, mandals and members started growing.  Now the Federation is working in 32 mandals of both the districts. It is a process and it continues until we cover all the 63 mandals in both the districts.
Homepagecarddetails3:
The Federation is focusing on five key areas:  
  1.Catalyzing the formation of multi-purpose cooperatives 
 2.Capacity building of the marginalized farmers to manage the cooperatives.
 3.Arranging finances, especially for process and for value adding investments 
 4.Providing technical support where required in agriculture, NTFP and food processing 
 5.Extending a market intelligence system for the cooperatives.
LegalStatusLine1: Sri Satya Sai Raithu Mutually Aided Cooperative Federation Ltd. is registered under Andhra Pradesh Mutually Aided Cooperative Societies Registration Act 1995
